description: Eight actual MaskGen-generated backgrounds and four TRAIN-only class-preserving composites. These are synthetic media, not additional real street observations.

images.label: night background
images.prompt: A realistic photograph of an empty residential street at night, warm street lamps, apartment buildings, dark blue sky, realistic asphalt road, no people, no vehicles, no signs, no writing.

images.label: rain background
images.prompt: A realistic photograph of an empty residential street in heavy rain at night, wet reflective asphalt, apartment buildings and street lamps, no people, no vehicles, no signs, no writing.

images.label: dawn background
images.prompt: A realistic photograph of an empty residential street at dawn, pale sunrise, quiet apartment buildings, realistic asphalt road, no people, no vehicles, no signs, no writing.

images.label: daylight background
images.prompt: A realistic photograph of an empty residential street in bright daylight, apartment buildings, green trees, realistic asphalt road, no people, no vehicles, no signs, no writing.

images.label: overcast background
images.prompt: A realistic photograph of an empty residential street under an overcast grey sky, apartment buildings, soft flat lighting, asphalt road, no people, no vehicles, no signs, no writing.

images.label: fog background
images.prompt: A realistic photograph of an empty residential street in dense morning fog, apartment buildings fading into mist, asphalt road, no people, no vehicles, no signs, no writing.

images.label: dusk background
images.prompt: A realistic photograph of an empty residential street at dusk, purple orange sky, apartment buildings and glowing street lamps, asphalt road, no people, no vehicles, no signs, no writing.

images.label: motion background
images.prompt: A realistic photograph of an empty residential street seen from a moving camera, slight horizontal motion blur, apartment buildings, asphalt road, no people, no vehicles, no signs, no writing.
